observations.detail: category-evolution-account-filter.ts applies NOT EXISTS Invoice scoped by organizationId and financialProfileId where Invoice.paymentTransactionId = movement.id for all, account, and card source modes.

category-evolution-account-filter.integration.test.ts closes the invoice, pays it, asserts Invoice.paymentTransactionId equals the returned payment transaction id, retries payment expecting CARD_INVOICE_ALREADY_PAID, creates an unrelated expense with the same amount and same description, and asserts totals 9000 overall, 2000 on payment account, and 2000 on selected card.

GitHub compare main..fix/593-reconcile-card-invoice-payments reports 4 changed files only: category evolution filter, its integration test, docs/API_REPORTS.md and docs/CARDS.md; branch is ahead 4 and behind 0.
docs/CARDS.md and docs/API_REPORTS.md define economic purchase versus cash settlement and prohibit inference by description, value, date, category, or cardId alone.
The exclusion subquery is scoped by both organizationId and financialProfileId, and the existing integration scenario retains cross-organization and cross-profile source rejection checks.
PR 623 is open, mergeable, targets main, and material head 2edd0a664e4ac53910a5f1d3fe6b41fe0f5d289f has CI run 32076098074 in progress at package construction time.
